odometryLock - Static variable in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.Swerve
Guards module/gyro sampling against concurrent access between the main loop and the odometry thread.
OdometryThread - Class in frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization
A singleton background thread that samples odometry-relevant signals (CTRE Phoenix status signals and arbitrary DoubleSuppliers) at a fixed frequency, higher than the main robot loop, and hands out per-signal Queues of the sampled values plus a matching timestamp queue.
odometryThreadFrequency - Variable in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.constants.SwerveConstants.Special
Frequency of the thread that updates the odometry.
odometryYawPositions - Variable in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.gyro.GyroIO.GyroIOInputs
High-frequency, offset-adjusted yaw samples collected since the last GyroIO.update(), parallel to GyroIO.GyroIOInputs.odometryYawTimestamps.
odometryYawTimestamps - Variable in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.gyro.GyroIO.GyroIOInputs
Timestamps (seconds) of high-frequency yaw samples collected since the last GyroIO.update(), for odometry.
openLoop - Variable in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.constants.SwerveConstants.Modules
Whether to drive without module velocity PID control
optimizeModuleState(SwerveModuleState, Rotation2d) - Static method in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveUtils
Optimizes a module's desired state so it never has to rotate more than 90° from its current angle, flipping the wheel direction (and negating speed) instead when that's shorter.
